The nameplate of an electric bicycle provides the following technical parameter table. Do not add any other content.

1. What is the internal resistance of the motor in this car?
2. What is the efficiency of the motor during normal operation?
3. At the rated voltage, what is the total power of the motor when it suddenly stalls?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The nameplate of an electric bicycle provides the following technical parameter table: 1. What is the internal resistance of the motor in this car? 2. What is the efficiency of the motor during normal operation? 3. At the rated voltage, what is the total power of the motor when it suddenly stalls?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image shows an electric bicycle technical parameter table, with the title on the right being “Rear-wheel drive DC motor”. The table lists motor parameters: the rated output power is 120 W, the rated voltage is 50 V, and the rated current is 4 A; on the left there is also information such as model 26 inches, vehicle weight 30 kg, maximum load 120 kg, etc. Then reason: During normal operation, the electrical input power of the motor is P_in=UI=50 V×4 A=200 W. The rated mechanical output power is 120 W, so the internal loss power of the motor is P_loss=200 W−120 W=80 W. According to the method of the problem, this loss is regarded as Joule heat I^2r on the internal resistance, so r=P_loss/I^2=80/4^2=5 Ω. The normal operating efficiency of the motor is η=P_out/P_in=120/200=0.60=60%. When it is suddenly stalled, the back electromotive force is zero, and the rated voltage 50 V is entirely applied to the internal resistance 5 Ω, so the total power P=U^2/r=50^2/5=500 W.
